Procedure
The student:
• measures 10 cm of 0.5 M aqueous sodium hydroxide using a measuring cylinder and
pours this into a conical flask
• adds 5 drops of methyl orange indicator to the flask, the indicator turns yellow
• slowly adds drops of dilute hydrochloric acid until the indicator just turns orange
• marks the number of drops on a tally chart
• adds up the total number of drops added and records it in a table.
The student repeats the procedure with 1.0 M, 1.5 M and 2.0 M aqueous sodium hydroxide
instead of the 0.5 M aqueous sodium hydroxide.
The student uses the same dilute hydrochloric acid.
The tally chart in the student’s notebook is shown in Fig. 3.1.
